title: lap_splits
description: Emitted by the room host's copy of the plugin when a pilot's JMT Liftoff Leaderboard plugin publishes a lap's gate times in the room (player properties JMTG and JMTS; see docs/server-protocol.md). They are checked and paired with the lap the plugin recorded for that pilot: the newest not yet paired, within 2 ms of the plugin's time and at most 60 s old. Sent after that lap's lap_recorded, in the same race.

steam_id.description: The pilot's Photon UserId, as on lap_recorded

lap_number.description: The lap_number of the lap these times are for

lap_event_ordinal.description: The event_ordinal of that lap's lap_recorded, in this race

lap_ms.description: The lap's time as lap_recorded has it

split_lap_ms.description: The lap's time as the pilot's plugin measured it: what the gate times add up to. Within 2 ms of lap_ms

prev_lap_ms.description: The lap before it in the pilot's run, as the plugin measured it; null when there was none

gates.description: The checkpoints' ids (GUIDs from the course's .race file), in the order the lap passed them

times.description: Milliseconds into the lap at each gate, one per gate, rising, every stretch of 0, times..., split_lap_ms at least 40 ms

seq.description: The plugin's sequence number for the publication

is_host.description: Always true when sent: only the room host's copy sends it
